title: Palantir首席执行官亚历克斯·卡普表示，只有华盛顿才能限制人工智能的责任：“这些企业必须被国有化”
content:

        With President Donald Trump and Vice President J.D. Vance chiming in on potential AI regulation in recent days, Palantir Technologies CEO and co-founder Alex Karp took his turn to comment on the topic on Thursday in a TV interview.  
            AI Regulation  
        When it comes to artificial intelligence and potential regulation, Karp says it's a societal issue.  
        "You have to find a way to set reasonable guidelines," Karp told CNBC during an interview on "Squawk on the Street."  
        Don't Miss:  
            Karp said the first line of defense is that you're liable for your own actions. The CEO said this means if you build something that can destroy 10% of the world, there are civil and criminal liabilities attached.  
        The first step is that if you disclose this, you need to share what you're going to do about it, Karp said. The CEO added that the second step is that if you're not going to be responsible, you have to get other people involved.  
        As one of the early AI leaders, Karp says Palantir has seen many things when it comes to AI safety. In the interview, he makes a case for and against AI regulation and what could be needed for the sector next.  
            Karp's View on a Solution  
        Karp said Palantir's partners are "livid" — not over AI safety in the abstract, but over what they believe is the theft of their "alpha," his term for the know-how behind how a business is run. That know-how lands in a model, he said, and shows up next door at a competitor. "And they paid for it."  
        See Also: Avoid the #1 Investing Mistake: How Your 'Safe' Holdings Could Be Costing You Big Time  
        The Palantir CEO offered up this analogy, which he said was the least vulgar from upset partners:  
        "How can they tell me not to wear a condom?"  
        The line refers to enterprises being told not to use the safeguards that would keep their data out of frontier models.  
        Karp says that severe liability protection would be needed in this case, and that the U.S. government is the only one that can cap liability.  
        "The view that I believe they have is, these businesses have to be nationalized because if you don't nationalize it every single one of my clients is going to sue."  
            Karp said there is currently too much risk and the potential for unlimited liability.  
         "You're saying, what is the liability risk for destroying 10% of the company, 10% of the world."  
            Image via Shutterstock  
       Read Next:  
          Building Wealth Across More Than Just the Market  
       Building a resilient portfolio means thinking beyond a single asset or market trend. Economic cycles shift, sectors rise and fall, and no one investment performs well in every environment. That's why many investors look to diversify with platforms that provide access to real estate, fixed-income opportunities, precious metals, and even self-directed retirement accounts. By spreading exposure across multiple asset classes, it becomes easier to manage risk, capture steady returns, and create long-term wealth that isn't tied to the fortunes of just one company or industry.  
          Arrived  
       Backed by Jeff Bezos, Arrived Homes makes real estate investing accessible with a low barrier to entry. Investors can buy fractional shares of single-family rentals and vacation homes starting with as little as $100. This allows everyday investors to diversify into real estate, collect rental income, and build long-term wealth without needing to manage properties directly.  
       Realberry  
       For accredited investors looking beyond traditional stocks and bonds, Realberry provides access to institutional-quality real estate investments, including a preferred equity opportunity in the 297-room Hyatt Place Boston Seaport. The firm has invested across multiple property types and markets, with 13 million square feet of real estate across seven U.S. states and $481 million in cumulative distributions paid to investors as of Q4 2025.  
       Skybound Entertainment  
       Entertainment franchises can become valuable long-term assets when they successfully expand across multiple platforms. Skybound Entertainment, the company behind The Walking Dead and Invincible, develops original intellectual property that spans comics, television, film, video games, merchandise, and licensing. With more than 250 IPs in its portfolio and a strategy focused on retaining franchise rights while scaling successful stories across media, Skybound offers investors exposure to the growing entertainment and creator economy through a private company rather than traditional public market investments.  
          Green Coffee Company  
       Coffee is a daily staple for millions of consumers, but investors rarely get direct exposure to the brands and supply chains behind it. Green Coffee Company offers a way to participate in the growth of the coffee market through its exclusive U.S. and Canadian distribution rights for Colombian brand Juan Valdez. With the brand expanding across major retailers including Target, Walgreens and Kroger, and GCC reporting 26X revenue growth over four years, the company is positioning itself to bring a well-known Colombian coffee brand to more consumers across North America.  
       American PowerGen  
       As artificial intelligence drives a surge in electricity demand, reliable power generation is becoming a critical part of the technology ecosystem. American PowerGen is developing natural gas-fired power plants in Texas, a fast-growing market fueled by AI data centers, manufacturing expansion, and population growth. By advancing projects through permitting, fuel supply, and grid interconnection, the company is positioning itself to help meet rising energy needs while offering investors exposure to the infrastructure supporting the next wave of AI and industrial growth.  
          Qnetic  
       As electricity demand rises alongside AI, data centers, and renewable energy, long-duration energy storage is becoming increasingly important. Qnetic is developing a kinetic energy storage system designed to provide long-lasting, chemical-free electricity storage, offering investors exposure to the infrastructure supporting a more resilient and reliable power grid.  
       EquityMultiple  
       For accredited investors looking beyond stocks and bonds, EquityMultiple provides access to vetted commercial real estate deals starting at $5,000, with only ~5% of opportunities passing their due diligence process.  
       FarmTogether  
       Farmland has historically held its value through market volatility and delivered returns uncorrelated to stocks and bonds. For accredited investors, FarmTogether offers direct access to high-quality U.S. farmland starting at $15,000 — fully managed, with no landlord headaches.  
       Fundrise  
       Private real estate and private credit can add income and stability to a stock-heavy portfolio. Fundrise offers access to diversified private real estate and credit strategies through an easy-to-use platform, with professionally managed portfolios designed to generate passive income and long-term growth.

report.summary: Palantir CEO卡普称AI责任风险过大，只有华盛顿能限制，企业或须国有化。
report.background: 近期特朗普和万斯就AI监管发声，美国AI治理争论升温。Palantir是政府与国防AI数据分析巨头，CEO卡普长期参与安全与数据伦理讨论。企业在使用大模型时担心商业机密和核心方法论（alpha）被模型吸收并流向竞争对手，而现有法律对AI造成巨大损害的责任边界不清。卡普在CNBC采访中提出，必须设定合理准则、明确民事与刑事责任，并由联邦政府统一限制责任上限，否则企业将面临无限诉讼风险。
key_points: 卡普认为AI监管首先是社会问题，应制定合理准则：开发者需为自己的行为负责，若产品可能造成全球性灾难，应承担民事甚至刑事责任。
他提出责任披露机制：若企业清楚风险，必须公开说明应对措施；若无法独立负责，就应引入其他方共同承担，而不是放任风险扩散。
企业客户愤怒的核心是商业机密被模型吸走：企业know-how进入前沿模型后，可能出现在竞争对手那里，而客户已为数据和技术付费。
卡普用露骨比喻称，企业不应被禁止使用数据隔离等防护措施；若政府要求开放数据，就必须提供严厉责任保护，否则客户会起诉。
他认为只有华盛顿能设定责任上限，否则风险无限；若没有国有化或类似兜底，AI企业将面对海量诉讼，因此称这些企业可能必须国有化。
report.impact: 对AI行业：责任上限与国有化言论加剧监管不确定性，前沿模型公司可能面临更多诉讼与合规压力。对开发者：数据隔离、模型审计、责任保险和合规披露将成刚需，闭源或私有化部署需求上升。对普通用户：若政策走向政府兜底，AI服务可能更集中、更受政治影响，但安全审查和事故追责也可能增强。企业客户与模型厂商之间的信任和数据边界将成为焦点。
report.tools: 想跟进AI责任与治理，可关注 Palantir AIP/Foundry、NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails、Guardrails AI、LangChain/LlamaIndex 私有数据接入、Microsoft Presidio 数据脱敏，以及模型卡/审计工具。企业侧可评估 AI 治理与合规平台，如 OneTrust、IBM OpenPages。
